Messages.Author: Peter D Bakija
Messages.Body:
What happens if a minion declares an action using an action card, and
while doing so, burns a blood to activate Flaming Candle (burn a blood
when you declare an action to make the action unblockable by vampires
and burn the candle), and then someone else decides to use a Direct
Intervention to cancel the action card?

I'd think that as DI is played as "a minion card is played", it cancels
the action card before the Flaming Candle is activated, but as Flaming
Candle is used "as the action is announced", it might be faster than DI.
Or not.

What happens?

Thanks,

Peter D Bakija

to the punch)?

B) They get the blood back?

C) They burn the blood as that is part of the candle but noth the
cancelled minion card?

opportunity to declare the use of the Flaming Candle, so no blood gets
burned. But I might be wrong.
